blueprints.name: PostgreSQL
blueprints.description: PostgreSQL 18 with a persistent volume. Other apps connect at <app-name>:5432.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Password for the PostgreSQL application user

blueprints.compose:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:${IMAGE_TAG}
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U \"$${POSTGRES_USER}\" -d \"$${POSTGRES_DB}\""]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
volumes:
  data:

blueprints.name: MySQL
blueprints.description: MySQL 8.4 LTS with a persistent volume. Other apps connect at <app-name>:3306.

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Password for the MySQL root account

blueprints.compose:
services:
  mysql:
    image: mysql:${IMAGE_TAG}
    environment:
      MYSQL_USER: ${MYSQL_USER}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ${MYSQL_DATABASE}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/mysql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "MYSQL_PWD=\"$${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}\" mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot --silent"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 20s
volumes:
  data:

blueprints.name: Redis
blueprints.description: Redis 7 with append-only persistence and a password. Other apps connect at <app-name>:6379.
blueprints.compose:
services:
  redis:
    image: redis:${IMAGE_TAG}
    command: ["redis-server", "--requirepass", "${REDIS_PASSWORD}", "--appendonly", "yes"]
    environment:
      REDISCLI_AUTH: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
volumes:
  data:

blueprints.name: n8n
blueprints.description: n8n workflow automation with webhooks served on the app's domain. Create the owner account on first visit.

N8N_URL.description: Public URL of the editor and webhooks

N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts saved credentials; keep it to restore a backup
